title: Rav Chinena the Elder
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Berakhot 12b he speaks in Rav’s name according to Ein Yaakov (our reading is Rabbah bar Chinena the Elder). In Pesachim 75a Rav Chinena bar Idi said to Rav Ada bar Ahavah: “But did not Rav Chinena the Elder say that Rav Assi said that Rabbi Yochanan said?” Dikdukei Soferim reads “Rav Chana the Elder said that Rabbi Yochanan said.”
We also find Rav Kahana son of Rav Chinena the Elder: Pesachim 76b.

notes.text: The supplied text fully writes Rav Assi, whereas the saved Davidson Pesachim 75a reads Rabbi Assi. Both title forms and the Ein Yaakov/Dikdukei Soferim variants remain distinct.

The consulted Berakhot 12b passages read Rabbah bar Chinena the Elder. The different Ein Yaakov and Dikdukei Soferim readings are Hyman’s edition reports, not independently inspected printed readings.
